messages.subject: Project Falcon - tax structuring note
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our tax DD on Wren & Hartley is clean - no material exposures beyond ordinary course. We're comfortable with the tax covenant as drafted (seven-year limit). For the funds flow, note stamp duty at 0.5% on the consideration. Happy to dial in on the completion mechanics if useful.

Duncan Reeves
Marlow Tax & Advisory Ltd
